test_FeaturesBuilder: test the FeaturesBuilder class to extract audio and text features from an events DataFrame over a time window
test_event_filtering: test that FeaturesBuilder correctly filters events to only include those within the specified start and stop time range
test_SentenceFeatures: test the SentenceFeatures class to build feature tensors from a sentence string with specified feature types
test_wav2vec_features: test Wav2VecConvolution or Wav2VecTransformer audio feature extraction on a WAV file with caching support
test_XlmEmbedding: test the XlmEmbedding feature class to extract multilingual word embeddings from a Word event
